cues.text: Getting started with Moda Interact takes just a few steps in Shopify.
Choose your store category, then select the product types you sell. This helps Moda Interact tailor recovery conversations to your business.
Moda Interact turns abandoned checkouts into AI-powered WhatsApp conversations, helping you reconnect with shoppers in their preferred language.
Shopify securely manages plan selection and billing. For this development store, we'll test the Free plan, which includes five lifetime recovery conversations.
Once Shopify confirms the plan, setup completes and the store is ready to recover abandoned checkouts.
